title: VTA Events — List — payload
description: A client lists the events the VTA holds for its principal in the trust contexts it has standing in. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

contextIds.description: Only these contexts. Absent: every context the caller has standing in.

from.description: Only events still running at or after this instant.

to.description: Only events starting before this instant.

cursor.description: An opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`, for the same caller and filters; the VTA refuses one it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the VTA chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: VTA Events — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/events/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/events/list/0.1#response.

nextCursor.description: Present when more items remain; absent on the last page.
